title: Evaluation square for integer-indexed sections
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K,K′$ integer-indexed complexes of abelian étale sheaves on $X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $\psi:f^*K\to K′$ a chain map. Put $\alpha=(f^*\underline{\mathbb Z}\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z})^{-1}$ and let $c$ be the Hom-complex map taking a degree-$n$ cochain $a$ to $\alpha;f^*(a);\psi^n$ [lem-weil-pbc-ext-pullback-hom-complex]. If $s_X,s_Y$ are the evaluation-at-one complex isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-ext-resolution-sections-iso] and $\eta$ is the global-sections unit, then $c;s_Y=s_X;(\eta_K;\Gamma(Y,\psi))$. No injectivity or augmentation condition is required.

proof.text: Expand complexSectionsIso and homPullbackMap on an arbitrary cochain. The fromSingleMk component formula reduces both sides to evaluation of α;L(a);ψ.
Use adjunction naturality for sectionsEquiv and postcomposition by ψ; the resulting component equality is the displayed square.

proof_origin.note: Intermediate evaluation square for the parent naturality argument.

theorem ceComplexSectionsSquare {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    {K : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℤ}
    {K' : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℤ}
    (ψ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ K') :
    SheafPullbackResolution.homPullbackMap (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f)
        ((upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).inv.app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{uNatural + 1} ℤ))) K K' ψ ≫
        (SheafPullbackResolution.complexSectionsIso Y K').hom =
      (SheafPullbackResolution.complexSectionsIso X K).hom ≫
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (ceSectionsUnit f) (.up ℤ)).app K ≫
          ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).map ψ)
